## Overview

## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Spaced practice** — Revisiting material over time with gaps between reviews
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Interleaving** — Mixing up different types of problems or topics during study
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Retrieval practice** — Testing yourself on material you've learned
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Elaboration** — Explaining concepts and connecting them to existing knowledge
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Concrete examples** — Specific instances that illustrate an abstract concept
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Dual coding** — Using both words and images to understand material
:::
